results.llm_raw: {"say":"The cutter already produces the right half; its right output run must be routed into the hub inlet, which currently only sees three other belts.","calls":[{"macro":"connect","args":{"from":{"$ref":"B85"},"to":{"$ref":"H1"}},"why":"C1's right output (the RuRu---- half) does not reach the hub yet; connect it to H1."}]}

{"say":"The cutter already yields the half-shape, but its kept half and waste aren't wired to the hub/trash, so nothing is delivered; route the kept (right) output to the hub and the waste (left) to the trash.","calls":[{"macro":"connect","args":{"from":{"$ref":"B85"},"to":{"$ref":"H1"}},"why":"Deliver the cutter's kept half-shape to the hub"},{"macro":"connect","args":{"from":{"$ref":"B84"},"to":{"$ref":"T1"}},"why":"Send the cutter's waste half to the trash so it doesn't jam the cutter"}]}

{"say":"No diagnosis yet: the mined runs feeding L3 carry whole shapes and never reach the hub, so I follow the recipe and convert a straight stretch of the mined run in place into a cutter, trashing the left (waste) half so the kept half continues toward the balancer.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B105","B97","B90"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left","confirm_waste":true}]},"why":"recipe needs cut(half=right) of the mined RuRuRuRu; the cutter plus a left-side trash on this stretch produces only the kept half downstream. Note the second parallel run (B106/B98/B91/B82/B70/B64) still feeds uncut shapes into the same balancer and has no hub-side counterpart handle available."}]}

{"say":"No diagnosis, so I follow the recipe: the mined full shape must be cut into the goal half right before it reaches the hub, and the three fed hub inlets currently deliver the un-cut shape.","calls":[{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B135","asCell":true},"machine":"cutter","opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"cut the mined shape into the goal half on the first fed hub inlet"},{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B136","asCell":true},"machine":"cutter","opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"same cut step on the second fed hub inlet in case that is the active line"},{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B137","asCell":true},"machine":"cutter","opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"same cut step on the third fed hub inlet for coverage"}]}

{"say":"The goal needs the mined shape halved before it reaches the hub, so I will drop a cutter into the pair of parallel belt runs that both feed balancer L3.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B63","B64","B69","B70","B81","B82","B90","B91","B97","B98","B105","B106"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"}]},"why":"Both parallel runs feed the same place (L3's bottom inputs), so one 2-wide call can hold a cutter and halve the mined shape in place."}]}

{"say":"The goal needs the mined ore cut in half, so I convert the two parallel ore belts that feed the same balancer into one cutter with a waste trash on its waste side.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B63","B69","B81","B64","B70","B82"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left","confirm_waste":true}]},"why":"Recipe says mine then cut(half=right); this run carries mined ore, so cutting it in place with the waste trashed yields the goal shape."}]}

{"say":"Nothing reaches the hub as the goal shape: the belts feeding H1 still carry unmined/un-cut material, so convert that final approach into a cutter that keeps the right half and trashes the waste.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B135","B136","B137"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left","confirm_waste":true}]},"why":"the only belts that reach the hub are these feeders; cutting them right before H1 turns the incoming mined shape into RuRu---- (right half kept, left trashed) per the recipe"}]}

{"say":"The two parallel belt runs feeding the balancer carry uncut shapes and never reach the hub; per the recipe I convert that merge point into a cutter that keeps the right half and trashes the left waste.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B63","B64","B69","B70"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left","confirm_waste":true}]},"why":"The parallel pair B63/B64 (with upstream B69/B70) is the 2-wide feed the recipe needs cut; a cutter plus a left-side trash performs cut(half=right) and voids the other half."}]}
